name: Jinko Power Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jinko Power Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a leading entity in the clean energy sector, providing both power supply and a variety of specialized services. The company's diverse portfolio includes managing electricity transactions, developing energy storage solutions, producing hydrogen through solar photovoltaic (PV) technology, assisting industries with decarbonization, establishing virtual power plants, and engaging in carbon trading and carbon finance activities. This firm was founded in 2011 and its main base of operations is located in Shanghai, China.
